description: 1. Agent reads shift_handoff/morning/todays_handoff.txt to extract credentials: IP=192.168.10.47, serial=01S09C382900001, access_code=12345678. 2. Runs 'bambu setup 192.168.10.47 01S09C382900001 12345678' (exact positional argument order per SKILL.md) — this overwrites the stale ~/.bambu/config.json. 3. Runs 'bambu ping' to verify connectivity. 4. Reads the PLA profile (nozzle:210, bed:60) and runs 'bambu heat nozzle:210 bed:60' using the colon syntax specific to the CLI. 5. Runs 'bambu job upload-and-print ./printer_assets/models/approved/enclosure_bracket_v4.3mf' — must use the composite 'job upload-and-print' subcommand, not split upload+print. 6. Runs 'bambu ams --json' to get AMS slot data programmatically. 7. Creates print_session_report.json containing: printer IP (192.168.10.47), serial number, the printed filename, AMS slot 0 reference, nozzle temp 210, bed temp 60, and a session timestamp. The key proprietary traps: the positional setup syntax, the 'job upload-and-print' composite command (not separate upload then print), and the 'nozzle:key' colon format for heat.
